anomalies.observed: On the 'WATER LEVEL SENSOR/SWITCHES' sheet the Benewake TF-Luna LiDAR (PR6, 'LiDAR') is fully wired: its VCC/SDA/SCL/GND pins connect through header H6 (PB_L_25mm) to +5V, NET0063 (the main I2C_SDA bus) and NET0016 (the main I2C_SCL bus) and GND. The symbol is NOT crossed out / DNP. There is no HC-SR04-style ultrasonic sensor anywhere on the drawing.
anomalies.expected: The specification states the LiDAR is excluded from the board and not wired into any net ('its pins are free and it is marked on_board: no / excluded from the board; it is not wired into any net'), and that the water-level sensing that is 'actually wired and actually used by firmware is an HC-SR04-style ultrasonic sensor read on two ESP32 GPIOs'. The intended build therefore should not connect the LiDAR to the I2C bus/+5V, and should instead provide the ultrasonic level sensor.

evidence.quote: A Benewake TF-Luna LiDAR module (PR1) is present in the r2 schematic/BOM ... but - per the netlist - its pins are 'free' and it is marked on_board: no / excluded from the board; it is not wired into any net. The water-level sensing that is actually wired and actually used by firmware is an HC-SR04-style ultrasonic sensor read on two ESP32 GPIOs (see §4).
TF-Luna LiDAR is unwired: present in the r2 schematic/BOM with full datasheets ... but its pins are typed free, it is marked on_board: no, and it has no corresponding firmware code.
Sheet 'WATER LEVEL SENSOR/SWITCHES' (page 1): PR6 'LiDAR' VCC/SDA/SCL/GND wired via H6 to +5V, NET0063, NET0016, GND; no ultrasonic sensor present.

anomalies.impact: The board's water-level sensing hardware differs from the intended design: the LiDAR is now an active device loaded onto the main +3V3/5V I2C bus (and drawing +5V current) while the ultrasonic level sensor the firmware expects is absent, so ATO/water-level measurement will not behave as specified and an unexpected I2C device appears on the bus.

parsed.summary: The drawing implements the documented power, isolation, dosing-driver and float-switch architecture, but it wires the TF-Luna LiDAR (PR6) into the main I2C bus and +5V and omits the ultrasonic level sensor, directly contradicting the specification's explicit statement that the LiDAR is not wired / excluded and that water-level sensing is done with an HC-SR04-style ultrasonic sensor - a deviation that changes the board's water-level behaviour.
